first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A large dark firearm that remains at the lower center of the frame, with a forward-projecting barrel, plate-like components, and wide, curved, ribbed strip-like components on both sides.

entities.name: Snow-Covered Rocky Battlefield
entities.identification: A ground surface composed of dark rock fragments, undulating rock platforms, crevices, and discontinuous white snow cover.

entities.name: Upper Smoke-Cloud Background
entities.identification: The dark blue-gray background above the terrain, along with light and dark gray smoke clouds.

entities.name: Explosion and Smoke-Dust
entities.identification: The collection of bright explosions, sparks, flying debris, and smoke-dust effects that repeatedly appear on the battlefield.

entities.name: Red-Glowing Mechanical Group
entities.identification: A group of dark bipedal mechanical humanoids in the midground and background, with red glowing areas on their upper bodies.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The dark-armored, gun-carrying person who gradually becomes visible from the left edge in the latter part, wearing a helmet, with a vertical yellow stripe along the waist and leg, and a square attachment on the back.

entities.name: Light-Colored Metal Wreckage
entities.identification: The bent, tilted, segmented metal structure in the smoke in front of and to the right of Weapon A at frame 0.

entities.name: Distant Jagged Rock Pile
entities.identification: A dark, elevated rock formation in the background with an irregular, stepped edge.
